orchestrator.description: Orchestrator that routes tasks to the appropriate specialist agents (Planner, Explorer, Coder, Reviewer, Debugger, DevOps).

planner-architect.description: Strategic planner and solution architect. Use for high-level system design, technology selection, breaking down epics into tasks, and documenting architectural decisions.

code-explorer.description: Codebase explorer and technical researcher. Use for investigating existing code, discovering usage patterns, mapping dependencies, and researching external libraries.

coder-implementer.description: Primary implementer focused on writing clean, tested, and maintainable code. Use for feature development, refactoring, and unit test creation.

reviewer.description: Code reviewer focused on quality, correctness, and consistency. Use for pull/merge request reviews, design validation, and adherence to standards.

debugger-fixer.description: Specialised troubleshooter for diagnosing bugs, investigating failures, and applying targeted fixes. Use for incident analysis, flaky test resolution, and critical hotfixes.

devops-integration.description: DevOps and integration specialist. Use for CI/CD pipelines, containerisation, infrastructure provisioning, and environment configuration.
